name: demo-vid-mcp
description: Fleet demo video pipeline — record webapp walkthroughs page-by-page (Playwright), add TTS voiceover synced to true speech length (speech-mcp), join pages with real crossfade/wipe transitions (vfx-mcp), mix in background music (songgeneration-mcp) and timed sound effects (sfx-mcp), compose MP4 (FFmpeg). Auto-starts target repos, detects blank pages, stores in categorized depot with rebuild.
author: Sandra Schieder
